title: q_max CI runs its jobs on the merge tool's batch branches (batch-*), not only claude/int-batch-*
why: q_max checks.yml runs jobs only for claude/int-batch-*, so a merge-tool batch head named batch-* skips every job and reads green (batch runner 11, #1158, 23:28 CST Nov 11).
source: coordinator 23:27 CST Nov 11, from batch runner 11
note: Stability fix. Lane started 23:27 CST Nov 11. Related: step all-skipped-reads-green. Owner page save 11:59 CST Nov 12: item 539 pick a: batch runner 11 merges q_max #1161 once with the red-main flag on the owner's typed override (D-705).
